import requests

AUTH0_AUDIENCE_ENV = "AUTH0_AUDIENCE"
AUTH0_SCOPE_ENV = "AUTH0_SCOPE"


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class IdentityClientConfig:
    domain: str
    client_id: str
    client_secret: Optional[str]
    redirect_uri: Optional[str]
    audience: Optional[str]
    scope: str


def load_identity_client_config(prefix: str = "AUTH0") -> IdentityClientConfig:
    domain = os.getenv(f"{prefix}_DOMAIN", "")
    client_id = os.getenv(f"{prefix}_CLIENT_ID", "")
    client_secret = os.getenv(f"{prefix}_CLIENT_SECRET")
    redirect_uri = os.getenv(f"{prefix}_REDIRECT_URI")
    audience = os.getenv(f"{prefix}_AUDIENCE")
    scope = os.getenv(f"{prefix}_SCOPE", "openid profile email")
    return IdentityClientConfig(
        domain=domain,
        client_id=client_id,
        client_secret=client_secret,
        redirect_uri=redirect_uri,
        audience=audience,
        scope=scope,
    )


def build_auth0_authorize_url(
    domain: str,
    client_id: str,
    redirect_uri: str,
    scope: str,
    state: str,
    nonce: Optional[str] = None,
    code_challenge: Optional[str] = None,
    audience: Optional[str] = None,
    extra_params: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None,
) -> str:
    params: Dict[str, str] = {
        "response_type": "code",
        "client_id": client_id,
        "redirect_uri": redirect_uri,
        "scope": scope,
        "state": state,
    }
    if nonce:
        params["nonce"] = nonce
    if code_challenge:
        params["code_challenge"] = code_challenge
        params["code_challenge_method"] = "S256"
    if audience:
        params["audience"] = audience
    if extra_params:
        params.update({k: v for k, v in extra_params.items() if v is not None})
    return f"https://{domain}/authorize?{requests.compat.urlencode(params)}"


def build_auth0_token_url(domain: str) -> str:
    return f"https://{domain}/oauth/token"


def exchange_code_for_tokens(
    code: str,
    code_verifier: Optional[str] = None,
    redirect_uri: Optional[str] = None,
    config: Optional[IdentityClientConfig] = None,
    timeout: float = 30.0,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    cfg = config or load_identity_client_config()
    if not cfg.domain or not cfg.client_id:
        raise ValueError("AUTH0_DOMAIN and AUTH0_CLIENT_ID are required")
    payload: Dict[str, Any] = {
        "grant_type": "authorization_code",
        "client_id": cfg.client_id,
        "code": code,
    }
    if redirect_uri or cfg.redirect_uri:
        payload["redirect_uri"] = redirect_uri or cfg.redirect_uri
    if code_verifier:
        payload["code_verifier"] = code_verifier
    if cfg.client_secret:
        payload["client_secret"] = cfg.client_secret
    response = requests.post(
        build_auth0_token_url(cfg.domain),
        json=payload,
        headers={"content-type": "application/json"},
        timeout=timeout,
    )
    response.raise_for_status()
    return response.json()


def get_bearer_userinfo(access_token: str, userinfo_url: str = "https://openidconnect.googleapis.com/v1/userinfo", timeout: float = 10.0) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    response = requests.get(

        timeout=timeout,
    )
    response.raise_for_status()
    return response.json()

+import os
+from dataclasses import dataclass, field
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+from typing import Any, Dict, Mapping, Optional
+
+from google.cloud import firestore
+
+
+GCP_PROJECT_ENV = "GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT"
+FIRESTORE_COLLECTION_ENV = "LOGIN_AUDIT_COLLECTION"
+
+
+def _utc_now() -> datetime:
+    return datetime.now(timezone.utc)
+
+
+def _coerce_str(value: Any) -> Optional[str]:
+    if value is None:
+        return None
+    text = str(value).strip()
+    return text or None
+
+
+def _coerce_bool(value: Any) -> Optional[bool]:
+    if value is None:
+        return None
+    if isinstance(value, bool):
+        return value
+    if isinstance(value, (int, float)):
+        return bool(value)
+    text = str(value).strip().lower()
+    if text in {"1", "true", "t", "yes", "y", "on"}:
+        return True
+    if text in {"0", "false", "f", "no", "n", "off"}:
+        return False
+    return None
+
+
+def _coerce_int(value: Any) -> Optional[int]:
+    if value is None:
+        return None
+    if isinstance(value, bool):
+        return int(value)
+    try:
+        return int(value)
+    except (TypeError, ValueError):
+        return None
+
+
+def _as_dict(value: Any) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    if value is None:
+        return {}
+    if isinstance(value, dict):
+        return dict(value)
+    try:
+        return dict(value)
+    except Exception:
+        return {"value": value}
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class LoginAuditRecord:
+    event_type: str
+    provider: str
+    subject: Optional[str] = None
+    client_id: Optional[str] = None
+    issuer: Optional[str] = None
+    request_id: Optional[str] = None
+    session_id: Optional[str] = None
+    success: Optional[bool] = None
+    error: Optional[str] = None
+    ip_address: Optional[str] = None
+    user_agent: Optional[str] = None
+    latency_ms: Optional[int] = None
+    claims: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
+    metadata: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
+    occurred_at: datetime = field(default_factory=_utc_now)
+
+    @classmethod
+    def from_dict(cls, data: Mapping[str, Any]) -> "LoginAuditRecord":
+        event_type = _coerce_str(data.get("event_type") or data.get("eventType"))
+        provider = _coerce_str(data.get("provider") or data.get("issuer"))
+        if not event_type:
+            raise ValueError("event_type is required")
+        if not provider:
+            raise ValueError("provider is required")
+        occurred_at = data.get("occurred_at") or data.get("occurredAt")
+        parsed_occurred_at = occurred_at if isinstance(occurred_at, datetime) else _utc_now()
+        return cls(
+            event_type=event_type,
+            provider=provider,
+            subject=_coerce_str(data.get("subject") or data.get("sub")),
+            client_id=_coerce_str(data.get("client_id") or data.get("clientId")),
+            issuer=_coerce_str(data.get("issuer") or data.get("iss")),
+            request_id=_coerce_str(data.get("request_id") or data.get("requestId")),
+            session_id=_coerce_str(data.get("session_id") or data.get("sessionId")),
+            success=_coerce_bool(data.get("success")),
+            error=_coerce_str(data.get("error")),
+            ip_address=_coerce_str(data.get("ip_address") or data.get("ipAddress")),
+            user_agent=_coerce_str(data.get("user_agent") or data.get("userAgent")),
+            latency_ms=_coerce_int(data.get("latency_ms") or data.get("latencyMs")),
+            claims=_as_dict(data.get("claims")),
+            metadata=_as_dict(data.get("metadata")),
+            occurred_at=parsed_occurred_at,
+        )
+
+    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+        payload: Dict[str, Any] = {
+            "event_type": self.event_type,
+            "provider": self.provider,
+            "occurred_at": self.occurred_at.isoformat(),
+        }
+        for key in (
+            "subject",
+            "client_id",
+            "issuer",
+            "request_id",
+            "session_id",
+            "success",
+            "error",
+            "ip_address",
+            "user_agent",
+            "latency_ms",
+        ):
+            value = getattr(self, key)
+            if value is not None:
+                payload[key] = value
+        if self.claims:
+            payload["claims"] = dict(self.claims)
+        if self.metadata:
+            payload["metadata"] = dict(self.metadata)
+        return payload
+
+
+class FirestoreLoginAuditStore:
+    def __init__(self, project_id: Optional[str] = None, collection_name: Optional[str] = None, client: Optional[Any] = None):
+        self.project_id = project_id or os.getenv(GCP_PROJECT_ENV)
+        self.collection_name = collection_name or os.getenv(FIRESTORE_COLLECTION_ENV, "login_audit_events")
+        self._client = client or firestore.Client(project=self.project_id)
+
+    @property
+    def client(self) -> Any:
+        return self._client
+
+    def save(self, record: Mapping[str, Any] | LoginAuditRecord) -> str:
+        normalized = record if isinstance(record, LoginAuditRecord) else LoginAuditRecord.from_dict(record)
+        doc_ref = self.client.collection(self.collection_name).document()
+        doc_ref.set(normalized.to_dict())
+        return doc_ref.id
+
+    def fetch(self, document_id: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+        snapshot = self.client.collection(self.collection_name).document(document_id).get()
+        if not snapshot.exists:
+            raise KeyError(document_id)
+        data = snapshot.to_dict() or {}
+        data["id"] = snapshot.id
+        return data
+
+    def query_by_subject(self, subject: str, limit: int = 50) -> list[Dict[str, Any]]:
+        results = []
+        query = self.client.collection(self.collection_name).where("subject", "==", subject).limit(limit)
+        for snapshot in query.stream():
+            item = snapshot.to_dict() or {}
+            item["id"] = snapshot.id
+            results.append(item)
+        return results
